title: 005 副本里的大活人-《第19次末日》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一时之间，谁也没有动弹，时间仿佛凝固了。

    突然之间，嘎吱一声，对面的门打开了。

    一个黄毛少年探出脑袋来，“靠！活人！我被一个三角形的老鼠怪，一屁股撅进这里来了！这是什么鬼地方，我搁家里就看到两个屁股！只有屁股没有头你懂吗？吓死人了！

    还是看到裤裆上的破洞，我才知道那是打印了一半的我爸！

    我叫林少凡，小姐姐你叫什么名字？”

    少年对上晏梨的视线，瞬间脸上写满了惊喜！

    他的声音格外洪亮，一下子吸引了所有的血色眼睛。

    林少凡瞬间红温，尖叫出声，“这这这是什么……”

    血色眼睛一下子躁动起来，它们扭曲着旋转着，像是一具具的尸体从水面中浮现了出来，眼睛有了脸，有了四肢，有了尸体，密密麻麻的挤在走廊上，几乎密不透风。

    他们多数都是白发苍苍的老人，脸上布满了蜿蜒曲折的皱纹，密密麻麻的都是老年斑。

    极少数的年轻人，不是没有心眼，就是没有脑袋。

    晏梨朝着不远处的楼梯看去，这是京都很常见的没有电梯的老楼房。

    她的任务是逃离青年路218号，要出单元门需要走楼梯。

    晏梨心中盘算着，瞥了尖叫着的林少凡一眼，没有应声。

    就是现在，趁着“尸体的眼睛”被吸引了，晏梨一个爆冲直接踏出门外，不客气的踏上地板上人的身体，快速地朝着楼梯冲去。

    “小姐姐！等等我！”

    随着晏梨的动作，走廊墙壁里，地板上，天花板上的人都开始不停地蠕动了起来，他们纷纷伸出了手，朝着晏梨的脚踝抓了过去。

    晏梨丝毫不为所动，继续朝前跑去，突然之间她听到了一声清脆的咔嚓声。

    只见前方的路突然断裂开来，地板掉落了下去，发出了嘭的一声巨响。

    晏梨下意识的停住了脚步，她余光一瞥，那黄毛林少凡也跟了上来。

    他脸色煞白，有些气喘吁吁的，差点儿一脚没有刹住，掉落了下去。

    “小姐姐，你太不厚道了！扔下我就跑了……不过也多亏了你……你是怎么知道，那些人都只能在墙里，不能触碰到我们的？”

    他说着，拍了拍胸脯，心有余悸的看了看到处张牙舞爪的人影。

    然后探头朝着坑洞往下看去。

    “糟了，这里是三楼，掉下去的石板直接砸破了二楼，掉到了一楼。我们要是跳下去会摔死！跳过去，那也跳不过去啊！除非是壁虎才能游过去！”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

For a moment, no one moved, and time seemed to have frozen.

Suddenly, there was a creak and the door on the opposite side opened.

A boy with yellow hair poked his head out, "Damn! A living person! I was pushed in here by a triangular rat monster! What the hell is this place? I saw two butts at home! Only butts without heads, do you understand? It's scary!"

It was only when I saw the hole in the crotch that I realized it was my dad who had half printed it!

My name is Lin Shaofan, what is your name, little sister?"

The young man met Yan Li’s gaze, and his face was filled with surprise for an instant!

His voice was extremely loud, attracting all the bloody eyes at once.

Lin Shaofan instantly became red-hot and screamed, "What is this..."

The blood-colored eyes suddenly became restless. They twisted and rotated, like corpses emerging from the water. The eyes had faces, limbs, and corpses. They were crowded in the corridor, almost airtight.

Most of them are gray-haired old people, their faces are covered with zigzag wrinkles and densely packed with age spots.

A very small number of young people either have no heart or no brains.

Yan Li looked towards the stairs not far away. This was a common old building without an elevator in Kyoto.

Her mission is to escape from No. 218 Qingnian Road. To get out of the unit, she needs to take the stairs.

Yan Li was thinking in her mind, glanced at Lin Shaofan who was screaming, but didn't respond.

It was now, while the "corpse eyes" were attracted, Yan Li stepped out of the door with a sudden burst, stepped unceremoniously onto the body of the person on the floor, and rushed towards the stairs quickly.

"Little sister! Wait for me!"

Following Yan Li’s movements, the people in the corridor walls, on the floor, and on the ceiling began to squirm. They all stretched out their hands and grabbed Yan Li’s ankles.

Yan Li remained unmoved and continued to run forward. Suddenly she heard a crisp click.

I saw that the road ahead suddenly broke open, and the floor fell with a loud bang.

Yan Li stopped subconsciously, and with a glance from the corner of her eye, the yellow-haired Lin Shaofan followed.

His face was pale, he was panting, and he almost fell down without stopping.

"Little sister, you are so unkind! You left me and ran away... But thanks to you... How did you know that those people can only stay in the wall and cannot touch us?"

He said, patted his chest, and looked at the figures showing their teeth and claws everywhere with lingering fear.

Then the probe looked down towards the pothole.

"Oops, this is the third floor. The falling stone directly smashed through the second floor and fell to the first floor. If we jump, we will fall to death! If we jump over, we can't jump over! Unless we are a gecko, we can swim across!"
